body.x: Pison contents(www.pison.kr) showcased Music distribution platform 'Music spray' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

'Indigo Station' is global platform on facebook base, the global social network, planning to release the end of January. This service is eminently suitable for indie artists who usually have difficulties in marketing and promotion. Providing points for those who click on 'Like' for 'Share', they let the music available for the people.

The official said "We will release overseas version of 'Music Spray', the on-line distribution service platform and we work on 'Indigo Stage' as offline version of indigo station. We would like to ensure new partnership opportunities.

Pison contents participated in the show as it had been selected for excellent startups by SmartContentCenter. Pison contents equally placed its service to let foreign reporters learn the service at Showstoppers which was important media press event. Furthermore, Pison contents had chance to get advice on global marketing from Strong Ventures CEO John Nam, Tapas media CEO Chang-Won Kim, KOTRA SV Sung-Kyu Lee at 3:1 'CES Global Consulting Program'

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
